creator: Alexander Terp
description: handoff::a_bridge_is_detached_as_replaced_and_attaches_again_to_the_same_screen failed once natively on aarch64 Linux under load, in the Linux suite ./dev --ssh runs afterwards, with 'the detach: the daemon hung up'. It passed 5 of 5 alone and in --linux minutes earlier. A bridge that sees the daemon hang up instead of a REPLACED detach would exit rather than reattach, so under load this may be a real race in the handoff rather than a slow test. Worth reading the detach order in the daemon's handoff before calling it a flake.
title: A handoff test sometimes sees the daemon hang up during the detach
